items.title: Observability, Monitoring & Telemetry: Keeping AI Systems Healthy
items.summary: Deploying an AI system is the start of a responsibility, not the end of one. Once a model or agent is live, you need to know what it is doing and why. Terms covered: - Observability: understanding what is happening inside a system from what it produces. A design property, built in rather than added later. - Monitoring: tracking defined metrics over time and alerting when something crosses a threshold - Model Monitoring: prediction accuracy, confidence scores, output distributions, latency - Agent Monitoring: what actions agents take, how they use tools, and whether they stay within their boundaries - Telemetry: the continuous collection of logs, traces and metrics that feeds all of it Without telemetry, monitoring is blind. Without monitoring, observability has nothing to analyze. — AI Fundamentals Glossary | H2O.ai University Full playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAWKlIKS-66E Free courses and certifications: https://h2o.ai/university #AIObservability #Monitoring #MLOps #AIGlossary #H2Oai
items.summary_html:
Deploying an AI system is the start of a responsibility, not the end of one. Once a model or agent is live, you need to know what it is doing and why.

Terms covered:
- Observability: understanding what is happening inside a system from what it produces. A design property, built in rather than added later.
- Monitoring: tracking defined metrics over time and alerting when something crosses a threshold
- Model Monitoring: prediction accuracy, confidence scores, output distributions, latency
- Agent Monitoring: what actions agents take, how they use tools, and whether they stay within their boundaries
- Telemetry: the continuous collection of logs, traces and metrics that feeds all of it

Without telemetry, monitoring is blind. Without monitoring, observability has nothing to analyze.

items.title: CleverTap Launches Clever AI To Cut Unwanted Brand Notifications In Real Time
items.summary: While mobile users receive dozens of push notifications daily, converting user intent requires moving past broad-segment spam toward live, individual personalization. Operating across 2,000+ brands in 100 countries, CleverTap delivers real-time decisioning by marrying historical behavioral data with live in-app interactions. By anchoring its stack on TesseractDB—a proprietary database built from the ground up for high-velocity behavioral data—and deploying clever AI, enterprise marketers can automate personalized user journeys while respecting privacy boundaries. In this exclusive interview recorded for Front Page, Sudhi Sachdev sits down with Anand Jain, Co-Founder & CMO of CleverTap. A self-taught programmer who co-founded Burp (acquired by Network18 in 2009) and launched CleverTap in 2013, He shares his journey in customer engagement. He breaks down the technical foundation of TesseractDB, live 1-on-1 personalization across retail and BFSI, setting budget and brand guardrails, leveraging clean rooms for tokenized DPDP data compliance, and the strategic rationale behind key acquisitions like Leanplum and Integration.app. How can real-time AI decisioning transform push notifications from digital clutter into high-converting customer experiences? items.title: ISRO Ignites Gas Generator For Methane Engine Of Its Next Generation Rocket
items.summary: ISRO is advancing its new methane engine technology to lower costs for future space access missions. ISRO is developing a 1,100 kN LOX methane engine designed to power its next-generation launch vehicle. This propulsion milestone marks a significant step toward making space access more affordable by enabling a reusable rocket for future missions. While a full engine firing is still pending, the progress highlights India's strategic push to reduce launch costs and compete in the global space economy. The development of this methane engine is critical for the long-term viability of heavy-lift technology. By shifting away from traditional fuels, ISRO aims to streamline launch operations and increase flight frequency.
